component.name: Dora
component.summary: Free, open source database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and more

description.p: Dora is a free, open source desktop database client built with Tauri and Rust. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, SQLite, libSQL/Turso, Cloudflare D1 and DuckDB, and opens CSV, JSON and Parquet files as tables.
Browse and inline-edit data, run SQL in a multi-tab console, write Drizzle and Prisma queries against the live schema, and sign in to Supabase, Neon or Turso instead of pasting a connection string.
